txt: *whimpers*
A gurgling sound comes from the direction of the non-responsive man.
He draws out a disgusting snort, then mumbles, waving a finger in your general direction: "Ugh... Abigail... don't ya... fuckin'... call Abigail."
He glares at you. "Don't ya fuckin' call her, hear me." His voice trembles with every word, becoming ever weaker. "Abigail," he whimpers in the end.
He snorts and beckons you to lean in closer.
He waves his hand, as if shooing you away, all the while murmuring something indecipherable.
His breath smells harsh like a toxic swamp as he whispers to you: "Don't call Abigail. Don't call Abigail!" He then waves his hand, as if shooing you away.
His eyes move around erratically, the look in them hazy and unfocused. "Don't call Abigail," he says.
The dozing man mumbles something inaudible.
The drunk man starts coughing, a really disgusting hacking cough.
The incapacitated drunk lays there snoring like an ancient rusting tractor.
The man hiccups, then mumbles something unintelligible.
The man looks around confused. "Don't... ya... ya call Abigail."
The man mumbles incoherently.
Then try to strike up a conversation with Don't Call Abigail about something other than Abigail (to no avail)... It's all about Abigail.
There's no waking him from his stupor. His mind is elsewhere.
"Abby? Don't call Abigail!"
"Abigail!" He grunts. "Don't... don't call her." He waves a finger in your general direction.
"Abigail!"
"Abigail... oh, Abigail..." He mutters while trying to brush something off his extremely dirty trousers. His movements are slow and awkward.
"Abigail..."
"Abigail?" His voice perks up, then trails into a string of random babbling. "Abigail, where are you?"
"Ar'ya... callin' Abigail?"
"Don'... don'..." the man stammers, "don't call..." Slowly, his head nods off to the side and he passes out, tongue dangling from his mouth.
"Don't 'ya dare to call' er..."
"Don't call Abigail! Don't call!"
"Don't call Abigail!" He snorts and takes a swig from his bottle. The bottle is empty.
"Don't call Abigail!" The drunk in the pipe snorts and takes a swig from his bottle. The bottle is empty.
"Don't call Abigail!"
"Don't call Abigail," grumbles an unshaven man with a ruddy nose. He narrows his eyes at you as if in recognition, then turns his head away.
"Don't call Abigail." The drunk man looks at you with his sad, swollen eyes.
"Don't call Abigail."
"Don't call her..." His trembling hand catches the paperwork. He lays it out on his knee and starts writing, slowly. The handwriting is almost illegible due to his shaky hands.
"Don't call... don't call her..." The drunk man speaks in his sleep. Drool dribbles from the left side of his mouth and down his jacket lapel.
"Don't ya call her, ya hear. Don't call Abigail..."
"Don't... call Abigail..." he whimpers softly, his voice trailing off into nothingness.
"Just please don't call 'er."
"Please... please don't call... don't call..." begs the man in the pipe.
"Shit, Abigail... please don't call 'er."
